_history: This call originally exposed a real bug: KafkaMetricsClient.alter_topic_config() used Kafka's legacy, non-incremental AlterConfigs API, which replaces a topic's *entire* dynamic config with exactly what's provided in the request. Patching only segment_jitter_ms silently reset retention_bytes (209715200 -> -1, unlimited) and retention_ms (180000 -> 604800000, 7 days) on this high-throughput topic. Found live while building this doc, fixed by switching to IncrementalAlterConfigs (gate-institute/k8s-manager PR #6, merged to master), rebuilt, redeployed, and re-verified below against the real endpoint on the real topic.
_result: retention_bytes and retention_ms are correctly unaffected by this single-field update -- unlike the pre-fix behavior, verified both via this endpoint response and a follow-up GET of the full config.
